prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: one fine-line plate for the heritage collection Fanggu. Image 1 is LINE STYLE ONLY, the Vairocana contour master. Image 2 is SUBJECT GEOMETRY ONLY. Create a refined sparse BLACK INK line drawing on perfectly flat opaque PURE WHITE #FFFFFF. Match elegant delicate thin organic contours, restrained internal detail, generous white surfaces. No fills, shadows, grey shading, crosshatching, grain, paper texture, gradients, halos or checkerboards. Door recesses are outlines, not black blocks. Show the selected subject complete and centered with 8% margins, verticals vertical and minimal perspective; photograph fixes identity and proportions. Remove tourists, trees, foliage, vehicles, wires, signs, clutter and sky. No letters, calligraphy, labels, captions, border or watermark. Exact seated Buddha statue from the subject photo, right palm upward at abdomen and left hand resting on knee. Preserve crown curls, robe folds, large seated legs and visible lower robe boundary; do not invent feet concealed by altar. No temple pavilion or unrelated altar furnishings. Portrait 1024x1536, subject about 82% of height.
